description: Source code for 'git merge-base' command implementation, handling various merge base operations such as finding common ancestors, checking ancestor relationships, and identifying fork points.

methods.name: show_merge_base
methods.description: Displays merge bases for given commits, optionally showing all or just the first.

methods.name: get_commit_reference
methods.description: Retrieves a commit object based on a string reference.

methods.name: handle_independent
methods.description: Handles the 'independent' mode, listing commits not reachable from others.

methods.name: handle_octopus
methods.description: Handles the 'octopus' mode, finding merge bases for multiple commits.

methods.name: handle_is_ancestor
methods.description: Checks if one commit is an ancestor of another.

methods.name: handle_fork_point
methods.description: Finds the fork point of a commit from a reference.

methods.name: cmd_merge_base
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git merge-base' command, parsing options and dispatching to handlers.
